text:
sara_hr: Heads-up team  Ryan Kim (Infra role) is flying in for a half-day onsite Fri 10:00-14:00 PT. He requested short access to the server room (to review rack layouts) and needs HSM-backed key access for a demo. Also asked about timeline for background check completion and whether we can provide a van parking space for his rental (he's bringing bulky test gear). Can ops/security confirm?

michael_ops: Hiring manager here  the loop is light: 2 tech interviews + 30m demo in the secure lab. HSM access is required only for the demo and must be supervised. We need the server room for 45m between 11:00-12:00. Please ensure escort & NDA signed before entry.

security: We can escort and allow supervised access. Requirements: signed visitor NDA (paper), government ID at desk, and completion of short background check consent form. HSM use requires a signed HSM access request (digital form) + sponsor approval. Also oversized-vehicle parking (van) must be reserved with Facilities.

it_admin: Loaner laptop available: Ubuntu 22.04 with `ssh`, `docker`, and our HSM CLI preinstalled. Note: HSM access requires token provisioning from CryptoOps and 24h lead time. If demo needs real keys we need the sponsor (Michael) to approve the key scope: `demo-read` only. Otherwise we can provide a simulated key with the same CLI.

sara_hr: OK I'll ask Ryan if simulated key is acceptable. Background check: is it possible to start same-day? Candidate submitted consent earlier but HR needs final e-sign.

security: Background checks: vendor SLA is 48-72h for standard checks. We can run an expedited tier (24h) with manager approval and $75 fee. If candidate already provided consent we can kick it off today.

michael_ops: Approve expedited check for Ryan, please proceed. For HSM scope, demo-read only is fine. I'll sign the HSM sponsor form now.

it_admin: Noted. I'll prep a loaner flagged `SEC-HSM-DEMO` and stage the test artifacts offline. Please confirm whether NVMe mounting is needed; any external drives must be scanned and mounted read-only by IT on-site.

sara_hr: Ryan will bring a small rack trolley and two sealed crates of hardware. Facilities: can we reserve the van parking bay and a loading zone permit for 10:00-10:30?

security: Booking van bay now. Permit code: VAN-22-RT. Front desk will ask for crates to be checked and will call security to escort the trolley to the service elevator.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Ryan Kim  travel: Seattle. Prefers USD reimbursement. Email: r.kim@example.com. Requested campus-letter for visa support: not required. Candidate indicated he can sign NDA electronically ahead of time.

it_admin: If Ryan can sign the NDA electronically, send the signed copy to security@company.com and we'll pre-approve escort. Also please send his driver's license scan to front desk.

michael_ops: Agenda (paste into invite):
```
09:45  Setup + IT prep
10:00  Intro / Hiring mgr (Michael)
10:20  Tech interview A
11:00  Server room walkthrough (supervised) + HSM demo
11:45  Lunch + buffer
12:15  Tech interview B
13:00  Debrief / next steps
```

sara_hr: I'll send NDA + background e-consent now and confirm van bay + parking validation (3 hours). Also will attach security note and loading instructions in the invite.

note_from_security: small reminder: no unsupervised access to racks, phones not allowed in server room, sanitized gloves provided.

itt_admin: One small technical note: HSM demo will require `HSM_CLI` v2.1; I'll image the laptop with it and lock network to internal subnet only. If Ryan needs internet for firmware checks, we need 24h approval.

sara_hr: Noted. I'll ask candidate about firmware checks. Closing loop  starting expedited background check and sending NDA now. Will update when vendor confirms. :pray:
